LESSON: TAWBAH

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.2: Tawbah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Tawbah
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should a Muslim seek repentance from Allah (S.W.T.)?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. state the conditions of tawbah as a basis for forgiveness from Allah (S.W.T.)
2. practise actions that lead to tawbah as a way of purifying one from sins
3. appreciate the virtue of tawbah as a condition for success in this life and the Hereafter

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)
